texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER PESTICIDE / FOLIAR SPRAYING - Calayan: pesticide, fungicide, herbicide, and foliar application should be deferred. Basis: wind speed is high enough to increase spray drift risk. ACAP calendar anchor: Sep 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Reproductive; Corn season 2 - Reproductive. Recommended action: reschedule spraying for a clear, low-wind window to avoid wash-off and drift.
texts.sms: DA OPS: Defer pesticide / foliar spraying in Calayan. Wind speed is high enough to increase spray drift risk. Check MAO guidance.
texts.lgu:
OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER PESTICIDE / FOLIAR SPRAYING - Calayan
Operation: pesticide, fungicide, herbicide, and foliar application
Why defer: wind speed is high enough to increase spray drift risk.
ACAP calendar: Sep 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Reproductive; Corn season 2 - Reproductive.
LGU/MAO action: reschedule spraying for a clear, low-wind window to avoid wash-off and drift; inform affected barangays and reschedule support services.
texts.facebook: Operations Advisory - Defer Pesticide / Foliar Spraying - Calayan: Please defer pesticide, fungicide, herbicide, and foliar application for now. Reason: wind speed is high enough to increase spray drift risk. Current crop calendar basis: Rice season 2 - Reproductive; Corn season 2 - Reproductive. Coordinate with your Municipal Agriculturist for the next safe field window.
